purpose: Select a candidate fast persistent staging device for temporarily used model copies while retaining durable originals.

comparison.basis: Repeated direct sequential read performance in this bounded test, not advertised specifications or complete model-loading measurements.

additional_observations.temperature_caution: Temperatures were sampled after the test, not continuously during it; absence of thermal throttling during the benchmark is not established.
additional_observations.filesystem_caution: Raw direct-device reads bypass exFAT/NTFS data paths. The WD slowdown is not explained solely by its filesystem.
additional_observations.hardware_caution: No SMART/firmware diagnosis or tests across multiple device regions were completed; do not infer a defective drive.

prepare_candidate_only_after: An explicitly authorized, safely writable mount accessible to the research user; do not force dirty or hibernated NTFS writable.
Verify usable free space and reserve host-disk headroom.
Validate bounded filesystem copy/write/read behavior before moving large model working sets.
workflow: Keep durable model originals in the archive.
Stage complete models, including every GGUF shard, in a dedicated owned directory.
Verify staged copy hashes and completeness before using the staged path.
Record source, staged path, hashes and ownership in a staging manifest.
Evict only explicitly selected staged copies after confirming no inference process is using them; never delete archive originals.
Measure archive-to-stage copy cost and cold-load benefit separately from already-cached generation.
staging_recommendation.wd_policy: Do not select the WD as the fast tier until its low read result is understood or contradicted by representative retesting.

subsequent_mount_setup.kernel_diagnostic_reported_by_user: volume is dirty and "force" flag is not set!
subsequent_mount_setup.kernel_recommendation_reported_by_user: It is recommened to use chkdsk.
subsequent_mount_setup.rollback_note: UDisks removed the former temporary mountpoint after unmounting, so the first rollback could not restore it. The setup script now recreates the validated prior directory before attempting restoration.
subsequent_mount_setup.required_next_step: Prefer native Windows chkdsk on the correctly identified Samsung volume and a clean shutdown before retrying persistent read/write setup; ask about Windows availability rather than bypassing the kernel guard.

limitations: Short time-based reads cover different byte extents within the same bounded region because device speeds differ.
Direct raw read bandwidth is not filesystem staging-write throughput, GGUF parsing time, or a full cold-load speedup.
Only one region and one block size were tested.

The benchmark did not change either filesystem's contents. A later authorized persistent-mount attempt was blocked by dirty NTFS; Samsung was subsequently remounted read-only for inventory and the user selected the existing root drive for staging.
The result does not change the earlier finding of zero physical disk reads during cache-warm GPT generation.
